name: Devilsight
body:
School divination; Level antipaladin 2, bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The target gains the same visual power of a devil.

They can see in darkness, and also in magical darkness, with a range of 30 feet. This vision, unlike darkvision, is in color.
